direction.description: Active sort direction for this column, `null`/omitted when inactive. The cell is controlled — sort state and toggle rules are app-owned: update whatever drives your ordering in the `click` handler.

align.description: Horizontal alignment of the header content. `'end'` right-aligns the cell (for numeric/right-aligned columns) *and* moves the sort glyph to the leading side, so the label stays flush with the column's right edge and lines up with the values below. Defaults to `'start'`.
